paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Vented Front Fender Set is engineered specifically for the BMW M4 G82 Coupe and G83 Convertible 2021+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, these carbon fibre fenders combine aggressive motorsport styling with genuine aerodynamic function.

Each fender features integrated upper louvres and side vent elements designed to allow high-pressure air trapped inside the wheel wells to escape efficiently. As airflow enters the front bumper cooling ducts, the vents provide a controlled exit path that reduces pressure buildup within the front arches, minimising front-end lift and contributing to improved aerodynamic balance at speed.
